Budgets re-measured from the committed artifacts: 570,096 / 800,000 rendered tris (106 parts; largest ctx-hemisphere-r 81,448), committed GLB 13,755,548 B = 13.12 MiB / 14 MiB (106 files, 106/106 manifest parts present; whole src/assets/anatomy tree 13,180,865 B = 13.18 MiB in 108 files, also inside the cap), imaging 9,132,531 B = 8.71 MiB / 10 MiB in 80 files. Telencephalon browser sanity: NO browser observation was possible, so every item is answered from the shipped data/sources/manifests and is published as such in the README's per-item table - 46 telencephalon entries across the 5 subdivisions (Basal ganglia 9, Cerebral cortex 10, Lateral ventricles 7, Limbic system 6, Telencephalic white matter 14 = 42 structures + 4 tracts); ghost shell translucent by construction and by state (GHOST_OUTLINE_OPACITY 0.05 taken by the default preset, GHOST_SHELL_OPACITY 0.14, hue #9fb0c4); the four new anchors lvl-tel-thalamostriate@48 / lvl-tel-basal-ganglia@58 / lvl-tel-centrum-semiovale@68 / lvl-tel-convexity@78 exist inside CLIP_BOUNDS (x -48..48, y -55..+85, z -75..+55) and keep the table strictly increasing; MRI covers y=+58 (station 57.50 au, 0.50 au away, 100% of stations in FOV) while CT is measurably out of source (58 > 36.25 au, 64.3% of stations inside), so Auto resolves to MRI and the UI must state the limit; the axial +58 plate (plate-tel-axial-58.svg) carries 24 labels over 19 distinct structure ids, all resolvable, at least one mapping to a telencephalon record; 3 telencephalon plates committed (axial +58 with levelId lvl-tel-basal-ganglia, sagittal hemisphere, coronal fornix) among 15 plate records (12 pre-existing + 3 v7). What a rendering engine alone could prove (scene luminance, live-section paint counts, the real WEBGL_lose_context cycle, pointer/focus interaction, on-screen translucency) is listed as NOT OBSERVED in the mirror's tier-boundary block and in the README.
